name: smwmusic-journey-to-silius-emotional-voyage-stage
title: Journey to Silius - Emotional Voyage ~ Stage 3 (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Stage 3 from Journey to Silius. Once again, it's a banger, just like every other song in this soundtrack. I love how emotional this song is, and it has this combination of sad and heroic energy to it that meshes well together so perfectly to create this wonderful song! Kodaka is a freaking legend!!!

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F# Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch, not compatible in-game (mod note: it inserts and works fine, but sound effects will detune))
2. F# Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
3. G Minor (Original Pitch)
